# Corporate Law This is the law by which Nanotrasen enforces order upon the station.
## Definitions Schedule A Narcotics - Minor and department restricted chemicals. Schedule B Narcotics - Major restricted chemicals. Pyrotechnic Chemicals - Flammable and explosive chemicals. Employee - Sentient beings who have a contract with Nanotrasen to serve as an employee aboard the station. Command - Sentient Employees with command access assigned by Nanotrasen or appointed by the Captain. Head of Staff - Members of command who reign over a specific department. Captain - The Nanotrasen dictated captain of the station. Acting captains are not awarded the same rights as the Nanotrasen appointed one. D-Class - Disposable Nanotrasen property to be utilized for experimentation, undesirable labor, and any other tasks.
